name: glm-agent-ops
description: Agent meta-skill plugin bundling two skills: glm-task-review (experience consolidation after high-complexity tasks, saving reusable task paths) and glm-auto-target-tracker (automatic goal progress tracking). Trigger for post-task retrospectives and ongoing goal monitoring. These are self-management skills for the agent itself, analogous to the meta-skill category in the official superpowers plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Agent self-management: post-task experience sedimentation into reusable skills, plus automatic goal check-in tracking with local vision recognition.
interface.longDescription: GLM Agent Ops bundles two meta-skills for locally deployed Codex agents, analogous to the meta-skill category in the official superpowers plugin. glm-task-review runs a silent post-task review after high-complexity tasks and distills the reusable path into a Codex user-level skill (skills sedimented into ~/.codex/skills/ belong to their user). glm-auto-target-tracker recognizes study/fitness/work/creative/habit check-in images through a local vision model, structures them into check-in records and maintains a local goal progress journal (preview first, then --apply to write). Zero vendor gateway credentials, no cloud calls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the glm-agent-ops plugin skills: <复盘刚才的任务并沉淀经验 / 目标打卡追踪>
